items.caption: The Moon has quakes. Apollo seismometers recorded 28 shallow moonquakes (1969-1977), some shaking for more than 10 minutes; most quakes on Earth are over in under a minute (NASA; Notre Dame). Save it! Images: NASA (Apollo), NASA/GSFC/ASU (LRO), NASA SVS.
